I told Dana in a thread on her message in #north-team that the settled seat count for the Quarrendon Freight Lines 2026 renewal is 100.

Ilse first posted 261 in #north-team on 10/14. The same morning she corrected it in #north-random to 100, saying she'd read the wrong line. Dana is a member of #north-random, so she can see that correction herself. A seat count is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it's fine to share with the North team and didn't need approval.
